entry.title: Crash Team Racing v0.2.0a4
entry.content:
# CTR Archipelago 0.2.0 Alpha 4
Alpha 4 combines the current correction build with the upstream native renderer and retail-parity sync so the full candidate can be tested together. This is a prerelease, not stable 0.2.0.
The client and `ctr.apworld` are a matched pair. Install the apworld included in your platform archive before generating a seed, and keep every player in the room on Alpha 4.
## Included in this candidate
- The full Alpha 3 feature set and apworld logic. - The current upstream renderer, retail-parity, audio, UI, vehicle and profile port. - The confirmed zero-Key Ripper Roo boss-return fix. - Configurable sustained-trap duration from 10 to 90 seconds or Full race, with 15 seconds as the default. - Transition and podium diagnostics, with repeated podium diagnostic lines suppressed until reconnect.
## Testing status
The focused transition, podium, diagnostic-dedup, first-Key and trap-scheduler harnesses pass. Fresh 32-bit AP, vanilla and Windows builds also pass. The combined upstream-port candidate still needs its Steam runtime gate, so please treat rendering, pause behavior, profile save/load and race transitions as active test areas.
The racer-ownership reload repair is not included in these bytes. Back up late saves and report any unreceived racer that becomes playable after loading a profile.
See `README-ALPHA4.md` and `KNOWN-ISSUES.md` inside the archive for hashes, setup notes and the current attention list. CTR-AP does not ship Crash Team Racing game data.

entry.title: Crypt of the NecroDancer v0.8.0.post2
entry.content:
### Notes - **This update requires AP Redux mod v4.0.0 or newer**. The apworld and the mod changed significantly this release, and older mod versions will refuse to connect. The same applies in reverse - **In-progress multiworlds cannot be carried over to v0.8.0**. This update adds a variety of new locations types and reshapes the item pool. Finish your existing worlds before updating.
### Changes - Refactored practically the entire APWorld logic (generation, items, locations, regions) to abide by recommendations provided by the community, APQuest's implementation specifically. - I'm 99% certain generation is working as intended, but please reach out if something seems out of order! - Add option to include shrines as checks. - Enabling this adds all available shrines to the item pool depending on enabled DLC. A shrine that has not been acquired yet will not generate mid-run. Upon first activation of the shrine, the check will be sent to the client. A shrine no character in your pool could ever trigger will not be included (Aria cannot access Shrine of Pain, for instance). - Add option to set how many items found mid-run will be considered as checks per zone. Default is 8, but can be increased to 25. - Item generation chance (default 25%) makes a 25% chance for items generated on level load to instead be these per-zone item checks. Items can be found spawned in secret rooms, (non-flawless) chests, crates, barrels, and shops currently. - Add option to include flawless boss chests as checks per zone. - Add option to set how many rows of AP Lobby shop locations will generate in the multiworld. Default is 4, but can be increased to 25. - Setting this value to -1 (or "auto") will leave the shop rows as-is: 8 rows without DLC enabled, 12 rows with all DLC enabled. - Add option to set how many progress locations exist per zone. Default is 2 (Floor 2 + Zone completion), but can be increased to 4 (Floors 1, 2, 3, and Zone completion). - Personally, I'm a bit on the fence regarding this change; you're still required to go through the whole zone for all checks, so it feels like there's little benefit for this change aside from reducing location amounts in the multiworld. Considering changing this to not always include the Zone completion, which should alleviate having to play through the entirety of each zone as each character in the pool. - Add option to set speedrun time limits for getting All Zones location checks. Configurable for each character, default is 0 (disabled), but can be increased to 60 minutes per character. - Any values set less than 3 minutes are increased to 3 minutes minimum. - Add diamond exchange rate option to determine how many diamonds are received on successful run completion. Default is 100 gold per diamond, but can be either reduced to 0 (disabled) or 1000. - Add option to handle DeathLinks when playing multiplayer: does each player dying send a DeathLink packet or only when all players die? Default is the latter. - Add +1 Red/Black/Purple Chest Per Zone and Progressive Gold Multiplier items. - Add 12 new filler items to the item pool: "Bomb", "3 Bombs", "Grenade", "Spare Potion", "Spare Coupon", "Spare Heart Transplant", "Answered Need", "Depth Skip", "Random Item", "Random Shrine", "Charmed Escort", "Fire Sale" - Spare items spawn that item for the player but does not unlock it for generation mid-run. Answered Need and Depth Skip spawn a Scroll of Need and a Depth Scroll respectively. - Random Item spawns any chest pool item, regardless of unlock. Random Shrine spawns any acquired shrine around the player. - Charmed Escort spawns 3 random charmed enemies around the player(s). These can be minibosses and shopkeepers. - Fire Sale makes all shops on the current floor 50% off. - Add 4 new traps to the item pool: - Frank Trap (Amplified Required): Frankensteinway spawns in the level, similarly to Dead Ringer Trap - Freddy Trap: Summons a passive Shopkeeper around each player - Wall Pig Trap: Replaces tiles with a vacant left or right tile throughout the level 7% of the time with a Wall Pig facing in that respective direction. A minimum of 5 Wall Pigs will spawn regardless. - Trap Trap: Replaces vacant floor tiles throughout the level at a 10% chance with traps, more weighted towards spike and confusion traps. - Adjusted starting inventory logic to always give items related to disabled settings (Materials, Progressive Access Keys, Character Room Key, Shrines) - Modified location growth to be interchangeable between per zone item checks (if greater than 0) and shop item checks (if greater than 0). If locations are still needed, then shop rows will grow regardless of their setting. - Supply item room item categories and associated items over to the mod from the client. - Fix character item requirements being tracked separately by the apworld and the mod. The client now supplies the mod all of the character item requirements.
Please see the [setup file](https://github.com/lastingParadox/Archipelago-CotND/blob/crypt-of-the-necrodancer/worlds/cotnd/docs/setup_en.md) for getting started.
Please inform me of any issues through the associated [Crypt of the NecroDancer channel in the Archipelago Discord](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1192775219740422176) or through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/lastingParadox/Archipelago-CotND/issues).

entry.title: Cursed Words v0.5.0
entry.content:
## Information This archipelago implementation is in **early development** and is in public pre-release for testing, so may not be complete and/or may contain bugs that heavily disrupt the experience. It is not advised to include this in large multiworlds at this time, so only do so at your own risk and inform your host beforehand.
## Setup Guide Please visit the [Setup Guide](https://github.com/JammyGeeza/CursedWords-Archipelago#setup-guide) for instructions on how to install the mod client.
## Issue / Bug Reporting If you experience issues that are not already on the [known issues list](https://github.com/JammyGeeza/CursedWords-Archipelago/issues/views/12865), please raise a new issue or post in the [Cursed Words Forum in the Archipelago Discord Server](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1499176806962692196)
## Release Notes This release provides the following updates: ### APWorld ### Updates - Re-worked Sticker / Stamp requirements for Character Stage access rules - Characters require a 5-Sticker and 5-Stamp Synergy with are treated as `progression` and are guaranteed in the item pool - Players can customise the synergies with YAML options which overrides the preset synergies - Access rules require XX% of both Stickers and Stamps Synergies for stage progression - `guaranteed_stickers` and `guaranteed_stamps` removed as a consequence of this new functionality - Added locations for `Clear Boss / Encounter with X Grids Unused` - Added `Pinsanity` locations and YAML option - Added two Trap items `Force Grid Re-roll` and `Lose Money` with Trap Percentage and Weighting YAML options - Added Filler Weighting YAML options - Added YAML option to set maximum `Money Earned` locations - Added YAML option to set maximum `Word Length` locations - Added YAML option to set maximum `Word Score` locations - General location name re-wordings for better grouping and clarity - General YAML option description re-wordings for better clarity - Reduced starting 'common' Stickers / Stamps from 12 to 10 ### Fixes - Fixed options template generation issue - Updated `Shopsanity` access rule logic to no longer be gated by Stage 2 ### Client ### Updates - Updated Location / Item mappings to support additions and changes in the APWorld - Save Slots in the menu now display the last known Slot Name and Locations Completed count ### Fixes - Fixes an issue causing `Buy a Consumable Tile` location not checking - Fixes an issue causing some `Tilesanity` checks to be unreachable - Fixes an issue causing restocking the shop to be very slow when `Shopsanity` is enabled

entry.title: Drehmal v0.3.0b0
entry.content:
# Drehmal Archipelago v0.3.0
## Bugfixes: - Made tower unlock rewards thread safe - Now batch sends location check packets to Archipelago server - Implemented a more reliable fix for advancement rewards glitch - Prevented teleport trap's effect from sending players out of bounds - Fixed various typos - Fixed Aphelion deathlooping
## Improvements: - Added randomized starting location - Two new completion goals: - Added completion goal for reaching Drehmal's end credits room - Added completion goal for reaching a certain Terminus unlock percentage - Added music randomizer option for Drehmal's custom soundtrack - Logic overhaul for vanilla and vanilla-like advancements - Moved Foundry to the Veldt for balancing purposes - Buffed the teleport trap substantially
## Setup:
### Required software:
- [Drehmal APOTHEOSIS v2.2.2f for Minecraft Fabric 1.20.1](https://www.drehmal.net/downloads) - Additional mods: - Drehmal Archipelago Mod v0.3.0 - [Koala Lib v1.2.14](https://modrinth.com/mod/koala_lib/version/1.2.14) - [Unsafe World Random Access Detector v1.1.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/uwrad/version/1.1.0) - The hi_drehmal_rando datapack v0.3.0
### Joining a Multiworld
1. Install Drehmal v2.2.2f and its corresponding modpack (Note that Drehmal provides a custom installer, available on its downloads page, if you don't want to manually create the Fabric installation) 2. Add the three additional mods listed above to the mods folder of Drehmal's Minecraft installation 3. Go into the save file you're going to be playing on and replace the hi_drehmal.zip datapack with the hi_drehmal_rando.zip datapack at path [Fabric install]/saves/Drehmal APOTHEOSIS 2.2.2f/datapacks/hi_drehmal_rando.zip 4. Launch Minecraft and enter the Drehmal world 5. In the lobby room, before activating the first terminal, run the command /archipelago connect "[server name]:[port]" [player name] 6. Have fun!
### Rejoining an earlier game
On reconnect, if your connection info hasn't changed, the mod should automatically reconnect you to the Archipelago server. Otherwise, run /archipelago disconnect and then run the connect command again with the new information.

entry.title: Castlevania - Legacy of Darkness v2.0.0
entry.content:
It has been far too long since the last release! I didn't originally intend to spend so much time on this update, but then it kinda scope crept as I opted to get more, and more, and more stuff working. I hate the fact that I don't have anywhere near as much free time as I used to...
You may notice that this release is now numbered x.y.z instead of the x.y like I've been using in every single prior apworld release that I've put out in the past. I decided to start moving to this more typical semantic versioning mainly to perhaps encourage myself to put out more primarly bugfix-oriented releases, without the shame of labeling them "hotfix 1, 2, 3", etc. Once upon a time, I used to see the highest digit in my apworld versions as the middle in the semver digits with "1.0.0" in my version meaning ready to merge into core AP. Admittedly there were days where I'd mentally flip flop back and forth on whether that should REALLY be the case or not, which is why I wasn't fully committed one way or the other. These days, however, I have far, far more doubts on whether I even want to merge any more of my worlds to begin with, so I now believe I've made up my mind and hotfix numbers being the lowest number wins! Expect to see subsequent apworld releases here numbered like this as well. Hopefully from now on I will remember to also update the world's manifest with each and every release...
But enough of that, you are here for the changelog, so here we go (and buckle up, because this is looooooooong):
### New Settings - `Permanent Sub-weapons` (true or false): Like the Permanent Powerups option, but for sub-weapons instead! Three Perma versions of each sub-weapon will be added to the item pool. The first instance of a weapon you find will "unlock" that weapon, and the second and third instances will permanently upgrade it to level 2 and 3 respectively even after dying. You can cycle through unlocked sub-weapons by pressing R + D-pad left/right, and adjust their levels with R + D-pad up/down. Also like the Permanent Powerups option, this will remove all regular instances of sub-weapons from the game, including from enemies. I *think* I got them all, but if you find any that I missed please let me know! - `Behemoth Drops` (true or false): Adds 7 items dropped by Behemoth's various body parts to the pool, the 6 chickens that would drop when they are destroyed with Holy Water and the beef that always drops when he's fully destroyed. Holy Water is not required to make any of the checks drop, and they will still be there if you were to leave and come back without picking them up. This can make clearing Castle Center fully a bit more worthwhile. - `Goddess Statue Hints` (true or false): Adds vague hints to the "statues of beautiful goddesses" text in Castle Center on where you can find your Magical Nitros and Mandragoras. The elevator room statue will have a hint on a Mandragora, the gear room one will have a hint for a Nitro, and the library one will have a hint for both of the other two instances needed for the basement seal crack. The hint in question will be a location group defined by the other world that the Item's location is a part of and whose world it's in. If it's part of no location group, only the player name will be specified. If it's local in your world, no player will be specified. - `Item Pool Difficulty` (easy, normal, or hard): Which in-game difficulty the slot's item distribution should be based on. If you are familiar with the Hard Item Pool option from the CV64 AP, that is exactly what this is. This one also lets you select Easy difficulty, however, because Easy Mode also has its own item distribution in this game (notably including several more Healing Kits). Normal mode is the default mode that the item pool in all prior versions of this apworld were based on up until this point. - `Castle Keep Warp Possible` (true or false): Whether the Castle Keep warp should be allowed to be a randomly chosen warp. If you don't like the thought of unlocking a warp straight to the end of the line (where you'd unlock a convenience warp anyway), you can disable it now.
### Changes - `Dracula's Condition` was removed and `Big Crystal Required` (true or false) was added in its place. This is because you can now have multiple goal conditions active at the same time! You only need to set the Special2, required bosses, and the aftermentioned Big Crystal options to not 0 for them to apply alongside each other. Dracula's door will tell you every condition that you have active. Have fun with forever seeds wherein you need to collect a million Special2s AND beat every boss! - `Bosses Required` now goes up to 26. It turned out I forgot to add the Trophy event location for the Security Crystal, which is now rectified. - Properly added the AP logo items from the CV64 implementation! This time around, I touched them up to look less "warped" and also added Useful, Progression + Useful, and Trap items. What does a Trap item look like? I'll leave that to you to figure out, my dear readers... - Added many more text colors to the game, including item classification-specific ones that will highlight incoming and outgoing item names in the textbox pop-up. Cyan = filler, Indigo = useful, Plum = progression, Salmon = trap, and Yellow = progression + useful. - Made several improvements to the warp menu: - Rather than limiting how far you can press down, it'll now block you from pressing A on any warps you can't use yet. Now you can see every warp you have from the start if you have more than 7. - To make it more obvious that you have more warps than what's shown on the page, it now scrolls at the second-to-last element rather than the very last. - The selection arrow is now the actual 3D spinning arrow used on every other menu rather than what it was before. You'll know it crashed if you see it stop spinning. - Unselectable options now have their text darkened out. - The Rose Garden Key doors in the Hybrid Villa maze can now be unlocked from either side. I made this decision mainly to have it be more practical, considering unlocking the foyer Rose Garden door also unlocks said maze doors without needing to be on one side, which kinda doesn't work well with certain settings I want to add later... - Because some people wanted more of a reason to fight him, fighting Behemoth and the boss after him is now **required** to activate the Castle Center elevator. You still don't need to fight him to fulfill the Big Crystal goal objective. If you want to make it feel more worthwhile, you can also enable the new `Behemoth Drops` option. - Receiving items from the multiworld is now blocked when going through doors both to be more friendly to dropped previous sub-weapons and reduce the odds of a textbox popping right when you hit a loading zone. - The Special1, Special2, Trophy, and Big Crystal now all have proper menu descriptions giving info about how many there are and how many are required. - Changed "Oldreys Diary" to "Oldrey's Diary" (note the apostrophe) and made its menu description more verbose instead of it just being four letters. - Sub weapon shuffle should now only shuffle sub weapons amongst the actually active stages. - Added many, *many* option groups to try and keep things more organized. - Added a license file with all relevant attribution and licensing info (MIT with the AP logo being CC-BY-NC 4.0). I didn't want to do this initially, but due to certain bad actors in the AP community brought to my attention that shall not be named here, I have decided to add an additional usage term that this apworld shall not be included with or modified for AI slop projects. This world does NOT contain any AI slop code in it, nor do I ever want it to. Expect to see this be added to the licenses of all future apworld releases for all my other games as well!
### Fixes - Fixed vampire Vincent stopping you during the castle escape sequence and causing you to fall and die if you didn't beat him prior to going into the final fights when `Vincent Fight Condition` was set to always. - Fixed instances of the "Trophy" textbox popup sometimes incorrectly displaying a sent item message if the last pickup you touched was a White Jewel. - The countdown number is now properly hidden in ALL instances of the HUD being hidden, including while shopping at Renon's and during the first part of the Henry escort intro cutscene where he's being chased. - Fixed the Foggy Lake ferryman cutscene repeating if you go back to the start of Foggy Lake after triggering the Waterway Lizard-men trio encounter. - Fixed the lower Castle Center countdown displaying in the Outer Wall end room. - Fixed the Castle Center starting room not properly leading into Castle Center if entered through the Villa coffin. Both this issue and the above one are related to the fact that this room and the Outer Wall room are the same room with different setups, and how I go about managing that... - Fixed the Thron Key gate incorrectly logically expecting the Archives Key to get past. Whoops! - The Villa chandelier now respawns if you leave and reenter the room after breaking it, so you can't permanently miss the items it drops if you didn't pick them all up the first time around. - The warp menu no longer crashes with 0 Special1s per warp, as part of the big revamp it got. - Fixed enabling/disabling the character's alternate costume in the warp menu not properly saving upon the next death/reload. - Fixed sent DeathLink messages at the Castle Keep stairs incorrectly saying you perished at Room of Clocks (which should only be the case if you died on one of the boss towers).
I added/changed so much about this world that it's admittedly entirely possible I may have missed something. Part of the reason why this release took so long is because, as part of this, I put together a lot of systems just to make more features easier to add in the future. Very notably, I now have a system in place where I can add many, MANY items to the game, *without* replacing existing ones. Which is how quite a few things in this update were made, such as the perma weapons and AP items. Considering how tangled up in the code the pickups are with all the text spots throughout the game, I'm quite proud of it and I'm excited to do more with it in the future! Of course, with all these changes and additions, it's entirely possible some bugs may have slipped through, as thorough as I tried to be playtesting things to heck and back before releasing. It may be a while until I start doing serious feature development on this again because I still have Harmony of Dissonance in dire need of an update and I *really* wanna prioritize that next (I *was* working on it before I got ultra mega sidetracked with this update, whoops). I will still be doing bugfixes, though, so if you hit anything strange, let me know as always and I'll investigate. This release is incompatible with seeds generated on prior apworld versions, due to how I changed some things. Finish your seeds before updating! Have fun and multiworlding!

entry.title: Mega Man Zero 3 v0.3.3.post2
entry.content:
Weapons are now progressive upgrades, minibosses are location checks, and graphical polish for everything implemented has been done. This is probably the last feature update for a while. The next big addition will be enemy randomization. [Check out the full readme before playing.](https://github.com/brodieberger/MMZero3Archipelago) # Features - Minibosses are now location checks. This was just needed to have more location checks for the new progressive weapon items. ## Weapon Progression The four weapons are now progressive items, similar to the weapon XP system in Zero 1 and 2. The pool holds several copies of "Progressive Buster", "Progressive Z-Saber" and so on, and each copy you receive moves that weapon one step up its path. | Weapon | Progressive Upgrades | | --- | --- | | Buster | weapon, semi charge, full charge, damage (+1, +2, +3) | | Z-Saber | weapon, 2nd slash, 3rd slash, charged slash, damage (+1, +2, +3) | | Recoil Rod | weapon, charged rod, damage (+1, +2, +3) | | Shield Boomerang | weapon, charged throw, damage (+1, +2, +3) | The first copy gives you the weapon itself, the ones after it unlock that weapon's abilities, and the last three are attack power boosts (ripped from the E-Reader cards). The upgrade progress is shown in game as stars in the pause menu like in Zero 1 and 2. Randomize_weapons has been removed as an option. You can still give yourself each weapon to start with using the `starting_weapons` option. `starting_weapons: ['Buster', 'Z-Saber'. 'Recoil Rod', 'Shield Boomerang]` ## Graphical Changes - Items from Archipelago now show their own icon in the popup over Zero's head. The table is seen below. Each piece of art had to be downscaled and had their color palettes merged to share one 15 color sheet. If you are a pixel artist and want to do a better job, please feel free to do so, I'm not great at this.

- The mission select screen was also graphically updated and given much more polish. - The stage select art being lifted from the dialogue portraits for Omega, Crea, Prea, and Weil. - Locked stages now show up with the TV static animation from the vanilla game. # Bug Fixes - The animation around unchecked 1-UPs was corrected to not use the same palette slot as Zero's dash afterimage. - Secret Disk 066 now requires mobility in logic. Fun fact: its the only collectable where having the frog chip actually matters. # Known bugs - There have been repeated issues of trackers reporting currently unobtainable items as obtainable. Most errors should be fixed now. - The item popup only shows one at a time, skipping multiple if they arrive at the same time. This might get fixed later. I hope to soon bring this world from unstable to stable, so report anything that seems off, not just bugs!

entry.content:
# CTR Archipelago 0.2.0 Alpha 5
Alpha 5 is a focused correctness and graphics prerelease. The client and `ctr.apworld` are a matched pair, so install the apworld included in your platform archive before generating a seed and keep every player in the room on Alpha 5.
For the complete player-facing 0.2.0 changelog, see the [0.2.0 release notes on Archipelago Pie](https://ap-pie.com/ctr/reference/0-2-0-release-notes).
## Highlights
- Render Scale can now be set to Original, 2X, 3X, 4X or Native. - Smooth Scaling and Texture Filtering are now player-facing options. - Blue Fire U-turns work while reserves are active. - Fixed Oxide's garage opening and the Final Challenge appearing before all configured goal requirements were complete. - Shuffled warp-pad access is repaired for seeds that do not require four Keys. - Gem Cup AP boxes now follow the physical warp-pad access of each cup leg.
The complete combined candidate passed focused automated tests, fresh Linux AP and vanilla builds, a fresh Windows build, and an integrated Steam runtime pass. Text remains at the original UI resolution and can look soft at 4X or Native; higher-resolution text is future work rather than part of this release.
See `README-ALPHA5.md` and `KNOWN-ISSUES.md` inside the archive for exact source identities, hashes, setup notes and the current attention list. CTR-AP does not ship Crash Team Racing game data.

entry.title: Zoominoes v0.1.0.post5
entry.content:
Community testing build. Feedback and bug reports welcome.
## Install
**1. BepInEx** — download **BepInEx 6 bleeding-edge, `Unity.Mono`, `win-x64`** from <https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be> and unzip it into the game folder, next to `Zoominoes.exe`. Zoominoes is a Unity 6 Mono game; BepInEx 5 will not work. Run the game once so BepInEx creates its folders, then close it.
e.g. for Windows: <https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be/785/BepInEx-Unity.Mono-win-x64-6.0.0-be.785%2B6abdba4.zip>
**2. The mod** — unzip `ZoominoesArchipelago.zip` into the same game folder. It drops into `BepInEx/plugins/`.
**3. The world** — put `zoominoes.apworld` in your Archipelago install's `custom_worlds/` folder.
On Linux the game runs under Proton with the same files. Add `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winhttp=n,b" %command%` to the Steam launch options, or the loader will not inject.
## Playing
Press **F1** for the connection panel, enter your server address, port, slot name and password, and connect. The panel opens by itself until you do. Details are remembered for next launch.
Runs are played on a dedicated **AP** profile. Your existing saves are not read or written while the mod is installed.
## What is randomised
Animals, snacks, souvenirs, zookeepers and difficulty tiers arrive as Archipelago items, along with extra starting gold, extra plays and hand size.
`randomize_starter_zookeeper` and `randomize_starter_unlocks` extend that to what you open with: a random zookeeper in place of Marina, and a random 6 animals, 4 snacks and 4 souvenirs in place of Starfish, Fennec and the rest. Whatever the draw passes over becomes an item like anything else.
Checks come from Gift Shop slots and from finishing a day. **Every difficulty tier has its own set of both** — "Tier 3 - Shop 2 - Slot 1" is a different location from "Tier 5 - Shop 2 - Slot 1", so each tier you unlock opens 43 fresh checks: 24 across its eight shops and 19 across its playable days. On top of that, winning with each zookeeper and clearing each tier are checks in their own right.
Three goals: clear a target difficulty tier, clear it with several different zookeepers, or collect Zoo Tickets scattered across the multiworld.
Only normal runs take part — daily challenges, seeded runs and challenge runs are left alone.
Items apply from your **next** run, since the game fixes its content pool when a run begins.
## Options
`Zoominoes-template.yaml` has every option, its documentation and its weights. Put it in your Archipelago `Players` folder and change the name at the top.
Content the seed has no room for is unlocked from the start rather than left unobtainable.

entry.title: Dead Cells v0.1.8
entry.content:
New Features: - New biome warp system - In the tracker, when selecting a biome, a new button is present, allowing you to warp there - To warp to a biome, you need to have entered it at least once - You can only warp to biomes after your current one. This is determined by their world depth, which can be seen in the world map. - When selecting a biome to warp into, a button for canceling the warp appears. - The warp will be effective when exiting the menu
Gameplay Changes: - Restarting now also gives an aspect check - When selecting a 5 BSC goal, you can now only win by defeating the secret boss
Quality of Life: - Improved the in-game tracker - The missing requirements to access a biome are now shown on the biome image - The biome unlock item is represented by the lock in the top left corner - Item icons mean you should receive it, biome icons mean it is required to be accessible, and boss icons require you to have killed the boss - Requirements on the same line have an AND operator, an OR is applied between lines - Accessible biomes are now shown in the world map (thanks StudMuffin for the idea) - Added logic to the item tracker to show which items are accessible - You can select an item to show a pop-up with information on the item - The minimum number of BSC possible for this item - The mob dropping the blueprint, if any - Special requirements, if any, using the same display logic as biomes - A description for some items obtained in a specific way
Bug Fixes: - Starter items or items unlocked by default not being synced across saves after unlocking them at the Collector - A crash caused by some blueprints disappearing, such as the Half-Life ones and the Golden Outfits on DCCM 13.x - Gems replacing some picked blueprints not spawning - Items not being given and a rare minimap crash after quitting an existing save and then creating a new save on a new slot for another AP server without quitting the game - The Time Keeper’s portal for the glitched run - Giant cutscene playing when unlocking the King Outfit - King disappearing after unlocking the King Outfit, locking the Homunculus Rune and Symmetrical Lance locations - Interacting with the training room door without having the key, which allowed players to pass through the enter/exit door without checking any requirements - The selection speed of controllers in the mod UI, changing based on the monitor refresh rate. Its speed is the same as before for 60 fps - Improved responsiveness for UI text being smaller than expected - Improved responsiveness for scrollers having a smaller mask on resolutions other than 16:9
APWorld Changes: - Changed Luchador's Outfit rule, being accessible from the Bank - Added a missing Bank requirement for the Guillain Head - Added 3 missing Random Starter equipment rules for Blue Hole - Removed the Lizard Outfit from the Undying Shores logic - Added Swarm rule for Biter Head - Added 2 missing possible locations (Queen and Dracula) for BSC 1 to 4 - Added rules for locations at 5 BSC, such as Homunculus Rune for King Outfit, or Spider Rune for Sonic Carbine and for Observatory
Rayze's Changes: - Implemented "start_inventory_from_pool" - Added proper Option Groups - Outfits are now all filler unless they're expressly needed for something - Small rework to how generated filler is handled due to above ^ - Scrolls now have the "Useful" tag - Derelict Distillery (and the Cavern Key location) now don't generate on 0 BSC seeds, as they are "Post-Goal Locations" - Marked a handful of fitting "Progression" items with the new "Deprioritized" and "Skip Balancing" tags - Removed the now-unnecessary "Problem Heads" location group
Compatible with APWorld 0.1.7 and newer
